bugs.title: Default transcript language should be English ("en"), not auto-detect
bugs.notes: Seeded 2026-08-28 (fresh sweep). Change default transcription language from "auto" to "en" at every layer where the default is actually applied: bot/src/github.js buildStageARequest options fallback, pipeline/stage_a/transcribe.py build_default_transcriber + Transcriber class defaults, .github/workflows/stage-a.yml opts.get("language", ...) fallback, and any CLI --lang default. Preserve explicit "auto" passthrough (language=None -> faster-whisper auto-detect). Update schemas/stage_a_request.schema.json only if it declares a JSON Schema default. Sweep repo (excluding _legacy/, jobs/, node_modules) for other transcription-language "auto" fallbacks. Run pytest pipeline/tests and npm test bot/test; update only tests asserting the old default, not tests of the explicit auto-detect feature.
